title: Senior Technician
meta_desc: Senior Technician job in Gżira, Malta: diagnose and repair vehicles for an established automotive group. Training abroad, health insurance. Apply now.
experience: Previous experience in an automotive workshop or a similar technical position would be considered an asset
qualifications: Strong technical knowledge of vehicle mechanics and electrical systems; fluency in Maltese and English; computer literacy
about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established automotive group in Malta, for an experienced and technically skilled Senior Automotive Technician to join its workshop team in Gżira.
You will diagnose and repair mechanical and electrical vehicle faults, carry out servicing and maintenance, and handle wiring harness repairs and road tests, always to manufacturer specifications.

As the senior person on the bench, you will also guide and train colleagues on more complex technical issues and support the Garage Manager with daily workshop operations. The role is full-time and on-site, with a competitive salary, health insurance and specialised training locally and abroad.
responsibilities: Inspect vehicles to identify mechanical, electrical and technical faults and decide on the repairs needed
Carry out vehicle diagnostics using specialised equipment
Perform full and partial wiring harness replacements and repairs
Complete servicing and repairs efficiently, within agreed timeframes and to manufacturer specifications
Conduct road tests when required to verify vehicle performance and completed repairs
Record all work, extra faults and servicing needs accurately on job cards
Review work orders with supervisors and plan repair procedures using technical manuals
Keep the Workshop and Aftersales Manager informed about vehicle condition, potential faults and safety concerns
Support workshop planning and work to the scheduled workload
Protect customer vehicles and their contents throughout the repair process
Handle tools, equipment and parts responsibly, including correct storage and disposal
Keep the working area clean, organised and safe
Stay up to date with new models, technical specifications and manufacturer standards
Attend specialised training locally or abroad when required
Give technical guidance and internal training to colleagues on complex issues
Support the Garage Manager with daily workshop operations and other duties when required
requirements: Strong technical knowledge of vehicle mechanics, electrical systems, tools, repairs and maintenance
A genuine interest in vehicles and automotive technology
Ability to work independently while supporting the wider workshop team
offer: Specialised training opportunities locally and abroad
Opportunities to develop technical expertise within an established automotive group
preferred: Previous experience in an automotive workshop or a similar technical position
company: Our client is a well-established automotive group in Malta, with its workshop team based in Gżira.
location_text: Gżira is a harbour town between Sliema and Msida on Malta's north-east coast, with the Marsamxett waterfront on one side and direct bus routes to Valletta, Birkirkara and the north of the island.
howto: If you have strong technical skills and enjoy sharing your knowledge, apply online through Outreach Recruitment using the form on this page. We aim to respond to all applications within 3–5 business days.
faq: What does a Senior Technician do in this role?

You diagnose and repair mechanical and electrical faults, carry out servicing, wiring harness repairs and road tests to manufacturer standards, and give technical guidance and training to other technicians.
Previous experience in an automotive workshop or a similar technical role is an asset. Strong technical knowledge of vehicle mechanics and electrical systems is essential.
Fluency in both Maltese and English is required.
Yes. The role includes specialised training opportunities locally and abroad, and you will keep up to date with new models and manufacturer standards.

The careers page does not give a figure; the role offers a competitive salary, health insurance and an employee loyalty card.
